title: Query probability under a randomized tree
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $\pi$ be a probability mass function on $\Omega$, and let $B$ be a finite Fourier basis for functions on $\Omega$ whose constant basis vector is the constant-one function and which is orthonormal for the $\pi$-weighted inner product. Let $T$ be a randomized decision tree with a finite nonempty seed space, a probability law on its seeds, and a deterministic tree for each seed; suppose each such tree computes a function $f:(\mathrm{Fin}\ n\to\Omega)\to\alpha$. For every coordinate $i$, the probability that the tree selected by the seed queries $i$, averaged over the seed, equals the probability that it queries $i$ when the input is independently sampled coordinatewise from $\pi$ and the seed is sampled from its law.
hypotheses_covered: Finite Fourier basis $B$ for functions on $\Omega$
Constant-one basis vector and orthonormality for the $\pi$-weighted inner product
Finite nonempty seed space with a probability law
A deterministic decision tree selected for each seed
